policy_violations.issue: PaddleOCR loaded in production web process
policy_violations.details: Lazy import in _get_ocr(). When OCR_ENABLED=true and first OCR request hits, PaddleOCR (including paddle/torch) loads in the web worker process. Violates production thin mode constraint.
policy_violations.current_status: Only import site in app/. Lazy, but still loads paddle/torch in-process on production server.

production_thin_mode_check.details: PRODUCTION_THIN_MODE env var check not implemented. No startup guard against paddle import in web process.
